summary: Social media app with profiles, Builds, Marketplace pages, and media upload functionality (reels and pictures).
known_issues: Upload button for reels and pictures is missing/non-functional

existing_features.title: Add a clearly visible upload button (or FAB) accessible from the main navigation or Feed page that navigates authenticated users to the Upload page (/upload route). The button must be present and tappable on both mobile and desktop layouts.

Verify and fix the Upload page (/upload) so that users can successfully upload both video (reels) and image (picture) files. The file input must accept video and image MIME types, the submit/upload button must be visible and enabled when a file is selected, and the chunked upload flow must complete without errors.
